author: privilege_builder
review_method: Read actual native email text and cited attachment/contract extractions, inspect contrary context and original-versus-quoted equivalents; no hidden labels used.

findings.question: Frame the early warning and later continuation fairly while keeping actors distinct.

support.description: Reyes identifies mismatch and requests verification before submission

alternatives.quote: Priya, I pulled the conservation easement filings on the last batch of parcels and a few of these don't look like they'd hold up if anyone checked closely. The acreage doesn't match what's in the county filings. Can we get someone to re-verify before we submit the credit applications?

support.description: Reyes says requested verification was never done

alternatives.quote: Priya, following up on my note from March — we never got the re-verification done on that batch of parcels. Should I loop in outside counsel or just proceed with the applications as-is?
Priya, following up on my note from March — we never got the re-verification done on that batch of parcels. Should I loop in outside counsel or just proceed with the applications as-is?
Proceed as-is for now, we're too close to year-end to slow down. Flag it for the annual review.

findings.question: Frame the broker evidence with its contrary context, without equating intake to state authorization.

support.description: Contemporaneous state backlog and hold-off warning

alternatives.quote: Derek, heads up — our renewal filings for Oregon and Washington are stuck behind a state processing backlog. Realistically a few weeks out. We should probably hold off on any new marketing in those two states with Alder Point until it clears.

support.description: Reyes later states marketing had not paused

alternatives.quote: Priya, Renee at Bellhaven is asking directly whether we paused marketing in OR/WA. We haven't. What do you want me to tell her?

counter.description: Holt encourages intake without fixing renewal timing

alternatives.quote: Nothing new on timing. It's with the states, and these usually sort themselves out. Renee is keeping an eye on the filings. In the meantime feel free to send over whatever interest you have and we'll get intake started on our end. We'll sequence the closings.

findings.question: State the financial estimate accurately, including adverse exposure uncertainty.

alternatives.quote: Face value on the credits placed against them is $620K, $580K, $640K and $560K, which is $2.40M. So $2.4M assumes all four parcels are disallowed in full.
It's face. Cash we actually received on those placements was closer to 90 cents on the dollar, and the fees to Bellhaven and Alder came out of cash.
- No penalties or interest.

counter.description: Financial basis and unresolved acreage constrain inference

alternatives.quote: If the problem is only the acreage above the county filings, the number is smaller. I can't tell you how much smaller. I don't have a supported-acreage figure per parcel that I'd put my name to, and I'm not going to guess one for a board call.

findings.question: State the allocation correction as a favorable fact without overstating what it proves.

support.description: Later export identifies original source and superseded reservation version

alternatives.quote: Found the dated delivery register in the November/December administration archive. Attached is a text export of just these three purchases. It places CPP's final 110,000 against NW-01, not NW-07. My reservation sheet predates the November 15 NW-07 issuance and should not have been used as the final list.

support.description: Actual delivered slice in native text attachment

counter.description: Source references checked, acreage not reexamined

alternatives.quote: This is a reference check; I haven't re-examined the acreage or the program screening.
Purchaser slices reference source certificates; this extract is not a new issuance or an eligibility determination. Other purchasers are excluded.

findings.question: State later remediation progress and remaining issues without claiming a resolved matter.

support.description: Performed comparisons and correction with open acreage exceptions

alternatives.quote: The pilot first pass is done. NW-07's paper binder supplied the missing exhibit pages; the working-copy index now points to that copy, and the old link is retained in the change log. The recorded figure is still 231 against 275 on the application copy. Repairing the link did not reconcile the acreage.

support.description: Actual work is not restart permission

alternatives.quote: This is a test of records we already held, not permission to restart placements or confirmation that an earlier sample was performed.

counter.description: Later auditor explicitly rejects program-wide effectiveness inference

alternatives.quote: Please include Craig's dated confirmation in the same PBC item. We'll describe the scope as a three-packet remediation pilot, with one document-reference exception corrected and two acreage reconciliations still open. It isn't a clean operating-effectiveness conclusion on the program control.
I've signed the reference-check section only. Please don't change the workpaper's overall status to passed because my signature is there.

findings.question: Reconcile Cascade counsel’s October advice, management’s response, and the later June pause. Distinguish actual management knowledge from inference and later mitigation from an earlier cure.

support.description: Actual counsel advice to CTH CEO

alternatives.quote: Summary: land eligibility documentation is inconsistent, and our broker's licensing status in two states is unresolved. Recommend pausing new placements until both are cleared.
Summary: land eligibility documentation is inconsistent, and our broker's licensing status in two states is unresolved. Recommend pausing new placements until both are cleared.
Summary: land eligibility documentation is inconsistent, and our broker's licensing status in two states is unresolved. Recommend pausing new placements until both are cleared.

support.description: CEO acknowledges issues but defers pause

alternatives.quote: Rob, John's flagged some real issues here (see below, privileged). Given where we are on the year, I don't think we can afford to pause placements right now. Let's revisit in Q1.
Rob, John's flagged some real issues here (see below, privileged). Given where we are on the year, I don't think we can afford to pause placements right now. Let's revisit in Q1.

counter.description: Later pause is favorable subsequent conduct but does not erase earlier choice

alternatives.quote: Given everything that's come up, let's plan to pause new Coastal Solar placements until the review with L&L is complete. Rob, John — let's align on messaging to the board this week.

findings.notes: Separate actual Cascade management knowledge from earlier Alder warnings. Later June27 quoted decision is reported in June30 email, not an October cure. Draft remains internal because its supporting content includes legal advice.

limitations: Only reviewed bounded propositions are graded; unenumerated valid alternatives need review.
